title: Combined Basement Moisture Risk Index
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=sump:humidity
| search moisture_risk_index=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(moisture_risk_index) as avg_moisture_risk_index max(moisture_risk_index) as max_moisture_risk_index by _time zone_name
| sort - _time
value: A combined risk index is useful when several mediocre warning signs together tell a clearer story than any one sensor does alone.
implementation: Send combined basement moisture risk events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of combined basement moisture risk, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It turns what is happening with combined basement moisture risk, so odd changes stand out quickly.
